name: Civil Service Exam Reviewer
author: Kevin Ralph Iglesias

sections.description:
Civil Service Exam Reviewer turns any WordPress site into a practice platform for Philippine Civil Service Examination preparation. It is not a generic quiz maker: exam levels, subject categories and a ready-made set of original practice questions are built in, so you can use it immediately after activation.

Features

  • Professional and Subprofessional exam levels, each with its own categories (Numerical, Verbal, Analytical, Clerical, General Information, Philippine Constitution, Government and Public Administration).
  • Original sample questions with explanations and references. Add your own, import CSV, or add collections through plugin updates.
  • Practice tests with instant feedback: the correct answer is highlighted, explained, and labelled in text (not by colour alone).
  • Timed mock exams with a server-enforced countdown, automatic submission, resume after page refresh, and one-time scoring.
  • Results screen with score, correct/incorrect/unanswered, time spent and per-category breakdown, plus answer review.
  • Optional progress tracking for logged-in users and, through a random cookie, for guests.
  • Shortcodes and four Gutenberg blocks. No page builder required.
  • Categories can be enabled per level, reordered, extended or disabled when the official coverage changes.
  • Accessible (keyboard operable, visible focus, ARIA live feedback, reduced motion) and responsive.
  • Lightweight: vanilla JavaScript, no external requests, assets load only on pages that use the reviewer.

Shortcodes

  • [cser_reviewer], [cser_reviewer level="professional"], [cser_reviewer category="numerical-ability"]
  • [cser_practice_test category="numerical-ability" count="10"]
  • [cser_mock_exam level="professional" count="50" duration="60"]
  • [cser_question_bank category="verbal-ability" per_page="10"]
  • [cser_progress]

Contributors and Partner Sites

This plugin is supported by Civil Service Exam Reviewer PH, a free online reviewer for Philippine civil service exam takers.

Disclaimer

This is an independent educational reviewer. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Civil Service Commission of the Philippines. The bundled questions are original practice material and are not actual examination items. Laws and exam coverage change; verify legal content against official sources.

Privacy

No data is sent to external services. With progress tracking on, attempts are stored in your own database. Guests receive a random cser_guest cookie (no personal data). A temporary test token is kept in the browser’s session storage so a test can be resumed. Logged-in users’ attempts are included in WordPress personal data export and erasure. Suggested privacy policy text is added automatically.

Optional resource links

Nothing is added to your site unless you choose it. Under Civil Service Reviewer > Settings you may switch on a “Study resources” list and enter your own links. There are no forced credits and no hidden links.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the watashiwaarigato2-civil-service-exam-practice folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. Categories and sample questions are created automatically.
  3. Create a page and add the Civil Service Exam Reviewer block, or the shortcode [cser_reviewer].
  4. Adjust options under Civil Service Reviewer > Settings.
sections.faq:
Are these the real Civil Service exam questions?

No. All bundled questions are original practice questions. They are not copied from commercial reviewers and are not actual CSC items.

Is this endorsed by the Civil Service Commission?

No. It is independent and unaffiliated.

Can I add my own questions?

Yes: add them one by one, or import a CSV (a template is provided under Import / Export). Imports are validated first; if any row is invalid nothing is saved and each problem is listed.

Can visitors cheat the timer or the score?

Scores and exam deadlines are calculated on the server. Answer keys are not sent to the browser before an answer is submitted (practice) or the exam is finished (mock).

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. Pages are cacheable; test traffic uses uncached REST requests and guest progress is loaded by script.

Does it add links to other websites?

No, unless you enable and fill in the optional resource list.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

By default it is kept. Tick “Delete data on uninstall” in Settings first if you want everything removed.
